purpose: producer self-review filter before requesting final independent review; not release approval
score_source: art_review/rubric.json dimensions/weights/floors; ignore historical character_policy and use active contract source
round_policy: Repair -> recapture affected evidence -> rescore. After three no-improvement rounds change method; do not automatically stop or request final review. Preserve real environment/permission/resource blockers.
self_review_identity: producer_self_review; same model may perform a separate critical review pass; never pretend independent
threshold_note: 90 is the producer self-review submission filter only. Independent art acceptance remains governed by art_review/rubric.json and its pass_total.
limitation: Scores are producer claims. Arithmetic, evidence hashes and mechanical checks cannot independently prove visual quality or honest observations.
